status_policy: Scenario values are CrucibleCraft DESIGN_POLICY, not GT6 source facts.

derivation_notes.seeds: Fixed seeds 24001/24002/24003 make worldgen and random sources reproducible; consecutive values chosen for readability, no GT6 source.
derivation_notes.dimension: Overworld only: the industrial mainline, T20 worldgen and all three T23 selected structures live in the overworld.
derivation_notes.loaded_chunks: small 3x3 fits a GameTest template region; target/stress 8x8 is the declared Beta-scale chunk footprint. Stress does not expand the map, only density.
derivation_notes.processing_machines: 3/24/96 = 1/8/32 per energy domain (RU/KU/EU), one machine per domain in small and a balanced 8x/32x scale-up. CC DESIGN_POLICY, no GT6 source.
derivation_notes.energy_converters: Counts converter PAIRS, not machines. pair1 = firebox + boiler (chemical -> HU -> steam, 80 HU + 1 mB water -> 160 mB steam); pair2 = fuel engine + dynamo (chemical -> RU -> EU, 32 RU -> 22 EU + 10 loss). Note: the handover sketch 'firebox -> boiler -> steam engine -> dynamo' is physically impossible in code - SteamEngineBlockEntity outputs KINETIC_PUSH (KU) while DynamoBlockEntity accepts only KINETIC_ROTATION (RU) - so pair2 is realized as fuel engine -> dynamo and the steam engine powers the KU machine (press) directly via the proven t18a adjacency.
derivation_notes.steam_engines: One bronze steam engine per firebox+boiler pair, feeding the KU machine leg (boiler -> steam engine -> press adjacency, t18a topology).
derivation_notes.ru_machine_powering: The RU machine (centrifuge) is powered by harness-injected RU (machine.insert(KINETIC_ROTATION, ...)) because the fuel engine has a single RU output face and RotationalGearboxBlockEntity is 1:1 directional pass-through, so one source cannot feed two RU consumers (dynamo + centrifuge). Mirrors the existing fillKu test idiom. Documented as the only synthetic power injection.
derivation_notes.fluid_pipes: 10/250/1000 item and fluid pipes each; pipes_total 20/500/2000 are divisible by 5 on purpose.
derivation_notes.pipes_total: 500 and 2000 chosen so the 5-tick position-phased schedule yields exactly 100 and 400 due pipes per tick (PipeTransferPhaseTest); small 20 -> 4 due/tick.
derivation_notes.covers: 4 covers in small exercise the major cover roles (pump x2, filter, valve); 24/96 keep a 1:1 cover-per-machine ratio at target/stress. CC DESIGN_POLICY.
derivation_notes.multiblocks: Only the three T23 selected structures are used; no new structure is introduced. small uses tank_3x3x3 (27 positions, 25 ports); target one of each; stress 4 of each.
derivation_notes.petroleum_chain: Reuses the T22 closed crude-oil family; no new recipe row. small has none (deterministic fuel injection instead); target 1 chain; stress 4 chains for density.
derivation_notes.warmup_ticks: 200 ticks is enough for boiler batches to settle in small (firebox 24 HU/t x 200 ticks = 4800 HU >= one 80 HU batch); 600 for target/stress.
derivation_notes.sampling_ticks: 1200 ticks = 1 game minute in small; 12000 ticks = 10 game minutes at target/stress. Values are DESIGN_POLICY; they gate the deterministic summary window, never wall-clock correctness.
derivation_notes.declared_evidence_class: small = MEASURED_AT_SCALE (GameTest suite). target/stress = STATIC_INFERENCE for bounded operation counts; wall-clock/memory/network at scale is explicitly SKIPped (no declared measurement environment; recorded in tools/t24_scale_evidence.json measured_at_scale).

small.purpose: minimum complete industrial mainline; fast functional regression

target.purpose: expected sustained Beta-scale footprint; used for release judgement

stress.purpose: amplify the same topology and work distribution to expose nonlinearity; never claimed as normal player load
